class.name: MovementSettings
class.brief_description: Physical movement and stance tuning for CharacterMotor3D.
class.description: Values are read live by [CharacterMotor3D]. Invalid authoring values are retained and reported by [method validation_errors]. All values must be finite and nonnegative. Heights must be positive. Presentation and input settings belong to the project.

method.name: validation_errors
method.description: Returns configuration errors, or an empty array when valid.

members.member: Downward acceleration in world units per second squared.
Upward speed applied on an accepted grounded jump.
Normal horizontal target speed in world units per second.
Horizontal target speed when sprinting and not crouching or slow walking.
Multiplier on normal speed for slow walking. Between zero and one.
Ground acceleration coefficient, multiplied by wish speed and elapsed seconds.
Minimum speed used to calculate ground friction.
Air acceleration coefficient. Uses uncapped wish speed for acceleration and caps the directional target with air_wish_speed_cap.
Maximum target velocity component along the air wish direction. Does not cap total horizontal speed.
Total standing height measured from the feet. The project maps this onto its collision shapes.
Total crouching height. Must be positive and no greater than standing height.
Ground crouch speed multiplier, between zero and one.
Maximum automatic upward step distance. Zero disables stepping. Requires a walkable landing at the candidate endpoint.
Maximum downward floor attachment distance. Grounded movement uses this to follow descending steps; jumping releases attachment.
